decisive_items: Increased expression of CD34 in the reticular dermis
response.rationale: Prolonged unilateral skin hardening with CD34-positive dermal fibrosis and no inflammation aligns with scleroderma (morphea), while fibroblastic rheumatism lacks the distinctive clinical pattern; lipodermatosclerosis is typically associated with venous insufficiency and inflammation absent here.

rejected.why: No evidence of venous stasis or inflammation; typical lipodermatosclerosis requires chronic venous disease.
Unilateral hardening and CD34 positivity are shared, but this condition usually has arthritis and papules; key clinical features are missing.
